summary: Executed issue51 regression via new executable Node harnesses + live read-only pytest API checks (no Expo/Metro preview per request). Stats/account isolation, community pagination handling, profile share behavior, app-link config generation, and website banner DOM behavior were tested. One critical resolver bug remains: incomingLinks traversal path (`/station/../x`) is not rejected to `/link-error`.

critical.issue: Preview base URL returned 404 for `/api/public-profiles`; live community checks only succeeded against `https://api.themegaradio.com`. This confirms environment/API-base mismatch risk for integrations expecting EXPO backend URL.
Live assetlinks still points to `com.visiongo.megaradio` while app package is `com.megaradio` (external website association blocker for Android verified links).

integration_issues.issue: `incomingLinkPath('https://themegaradio.com/station/../x')` returns original URL instead of `/link-error`; traversal-like path is not rejected as required.
`app/statistics.tsx` has owner snapshot/loading/stale callback guard, but no visible reset control was found despite issue51 requirement mentioning reset handling at screen level.

action_items: Fix `src/utils/incomingLinks.ts` to hard-reject traversal patterns like `..` segments for recognized domains/schemes and return `/link-error`.
Align frontend API base usage with environment configuration (currently `src/constants/api.ts` + `src/services/api.ts` hardcode host/key, bypassing EXPO backend URL routing).
If product requires statistics reset from statistics screen, add explicit UI action and testID, then retest owner-scoped reset flow.
External website owner must update Android assetlinks package/cert entries to `com.megaradio` + correct Play signing fingerprint.
critical_code_review_comments: `src/services/api.ts` hardcodes API host + X-API-Key; this violates env-only URL/credential policy and can diverge from preview routing behavior.
Stats service regression scenarios passed: owner capture before async read, queued serialization, guest/account isolation, stale-session non-charging, and no endSession song increments.
Community directory normalization/pagination behavior is correctly defensive against repeated page payloads and private-profile exclusion on client side.

Open-link resolver has proper stale-callback guard (`active` flag) and same-station non-toggle behavior, but upstream path sanitization bug in `incomingLinks` still allows traversal-style path to bypass `/link-error` output.
seed_data_creation: None (read-only API checks + isolated JS test doubles only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: No Expo/Metro preview testing executed by request. Node regression harnesses are reusable and executable. One harness intentionally fails at the incoming link traversal assertion to keep the unresolved security/integration bug visible.
rca_of_issue: Root cause for failing universal-link case: `incomingLinkPath` uses `new URL()` normalization, so `/station/../x` canonicalizes and falls through to returning original path instead of being blocked. Mitigation: inspect raw path before normalization or explicitly reject dot-segments (`..`) for recognized website/app-link routes before routing decisions.
